title: Supply chain concerns cloud India’s holiday season export outlook
content:
As holiday-season shipments get underway, Indian apparel and home textile exporters are navigating choppy waters. 
The West Asia crisis has reportedly disrupted key trade routes and driven up freight costs, while longer payment cycles are tying up more working capital. 
Exporters hope easing geopolitical tensions will help restore logistics stability.

title: India’s Odisha to set up textile cluster on defunct spinning mill site
content:
India’s Odisha state has decided to set up a modern textile industry cluster in the premises of Shree Sarala Weavers Cooperative Spinning Mill at Tirtol in Jagatsinghpur district. 
The mill has been closed since 1999. 
As a first step, Odisha Industrial Infrastructure Development Corporation has given $2.41 million to the handloom and knitting industries department to get possession of the mill property.

title: Indian textile industry poised to hit $350 bn by 2030: Minister
content:
India’s domestic textile market has grown from about $63 billion in FY15 to over $168.2 billion now, reflecting robust expansion and increasing contribution to the economy, according to Minister of Textiles Giriraj Singh.
The country’s textile industry has expanded to nearly $190 billion in FY26 and is poised to hit $350 billion by 2030.
India has emerged as a major force in technical textiles as well.

title: Poland’s LPP posts strong Q1 as profit jumps 42%
content:
Poland’s LPP has reported strong Q1 2026 results, with revenue rising 11 per cent YoY to PLN 5.5 billion (~$1.485 billion) and net profit increasing 42 per cent. 
EBITDA grew 36 per cent to PLN 1.3 billion (~$351 million), supported by a record 58.5 per cent gross margin and cost discipline. 
The retailer opened 121 stores, led by Sinsay, while investing in retail expansion and logistics infrastructure.
